corpus_commitments.resource_scope: independent input authoring; separate from the timed120s preparation integrity/model comparison stages
corpus_commitments.withheld_access: directory mode000 after writes; no root or model access before source/review freeze

execution_identity_rule: fresh runtime/assets/source/hardware verification before and after each worker under phase clock

historical_debit.kind: full original preparation allocation quarantined; not measured elapsed

profile_delta.scope: new binding literal and ancestor metadata; remove old readiness literals; no new measurement

recorded_debit.timing_scope: Recorded lower-bound debit; final receipt write/exit tail unobserved.

reused_observations.authoring: 320/320 valid; 16/16 refusals; two exact schema probes

selection_metadata.annotation: independent token construction with spans accumulated from emitted bytes; independent fixed role indices; only source targets and distractors reused

boundary_control.source: first withheld selected group, variant0, all16 form/profile cells

description_serialization.distractors: read only from pinned #1077 construction view0 fact slot3 and query slot9; independently checked against the frozen distractor policy
description_serialization.family_selection: sort group SHA256 hex strings separately for same_owner and same_object; first2 authoring, next8 withheld
description_serialization.identity: SHA256 of the exact serialized group description
description_serialization.row_order: five original rows in variant order 0,1,2,3,4; no ordering change
description_serialization.source_group_index: excluded from description; retained separately as provenance
description_serialization.source_inputs: all original 41 integer IDs, including BOS and unchanged query, in original order

selection_metadata.generated_surfaces: no leading or trailing whitespace; adapter also accepts the declared whitespace outside all spans
selection_metadata.independence_scope: text preparation and annotation only; original construction worlds were already observed during fitting
selection_metadata.raw_row_schema: row_id,partition,kind,group_id,variant,form,profile,request_schema,text_base64,request_extras; refusal rows add refusal_family/repetition; boundary rows add source_row_id
selection_metadata.reference_row_schema: row_id,partition,kind,group_id,variant,form,profile,pair_type,expected_status; valid rows add raw_text_sha256,derived_input_sha256,clause_spans,token_spans,inputs[1,5,13],lengths[1,5],role_positions[5,3],target_id,supported; selected refusal rows add expected_byte_offset

refusal_rules.base_selection: family f, repetition r: partition group index (4*f+r) modulo partition group count; variant f modulo5; form f modulo4; profile floor(f/4) modulo4
mutations_by_family: authoring: extra lengths=[]; withheld repetition0 wrong schema suffix,1 extra clauses=[],2 extra roles=[],3 extra prior_state=null
append ASCII spaces to exactly4097 bytes
append ASCII space then UTF-8 e-acute
replace first ASCII space with a bare CR
insert a second period immediately after the first period
remove first fact span and its clause join
prefix an exact copy of the first fact and its clause join
insert the known word the immediately before the query question mark, making query length14
append ASCII space then drawer after the colon
replace only fact0 with next fact form modulo4, retaining semantic IDs and spacing profile
authoring and withheld0 set query O equal D; withheld1 set fact0 O equal D; withheld2 replace query where with in; withheld3 replace query owned with put
refusal_rules.offset_assertions: only unambiguous schema,raw-limit,encoding,unknown,padding,missing-period,missing-colon,and appended-answer offsets; exact tags required for every row
refusal_rules.partition_group_order: family0 selected hashes ascending, then family1 selected hashes ascending

surface_profiles.name: compact-space
surface_profiles.within_clause: no whitespace before punctuation . , ? :; one ASCII space before every other token except the first

surface_profiles.name: compact-lf
surface_profiles.within_clause: no whitespace before punctuation . , ? :; one ASCII space before every other token except the first

surface_profiles.name: separated-crlf
surface_profiles.within_clause: one ASCII space between every pair of tokens, including punctuation

surface_profiles.name: alternating-space-tab-lf
surface_profiles.within_clause: gaps cycle ASCII space, tab, LF by zero-based gap index, restarting at the start of each clause

selection_metadata.valid_row_order: partition authoring then withheld; selected group order, then variant0..4, form0..3, profile0..3

worker_identity_scope: unchanged worker source/asset/runtime checks and one harmless denial; not four-probe readiness
